s.note: Cheddar and cream cheese ball with cranberries, rolled in walnuts
s.how: Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 150g grated vintage cheddar, 60g chopped dried cranberries, 1 tbsp chopped chives and 1/2 tsp garlic powder. Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and chill for 1 hour until firm. Toast 70g walnuts in a dry pan for 4 minutes, chop finely and mix with 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Roll the ball in the mix until coated. Serve with 200g crackers.

s.n: North Pole pumpkin and sage soup
s.note: Roast pumpkin soup with crisp sage and toasted pepitas
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Roast the pumpkin and onion with the oil and salt for 35 minutes. Blend with the stock until smooth, then heat through with the cream. Season. Fry the sage leaves in the butter until crisp and toast the pepitas in the same pan. Serve topped with the sage butter and pepitas.

m.note: Thyme butter roast chicken with potatoes and carrots
m.how: Rub a whole chicken with 40g butter and thyme and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes. Add 800g halved potatoes and 3 carrots to the tray for the last 50 minutes and rest before carving.

w.note: Chocolate brownies with white chocolate and crushed candy cane
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g caster sugar, then 3 eggs, 1/2 tsp peppermint extract and a pinch of salt. Fold in 100g plain flour and 30g cocoa. Spread into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 170C for 25 minutes until just set. Cool completely. Melt 120g white chocolate and spread over the top, then scatter with 4 crushed candy canes. Chill 20 minutes and cut into 16 squares.

w.note: Buttery cut-out cookies iced red and green
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 300g plain flour and chill. Roll out, cut stars and trees and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Ice with 250g icing sugar tinted red and green.

d.note: Hot chocolate with peppermint, whipped cream and a candy cane
d.how: Heat 1L full cream milk with 2 tbsp caster sugar until steaming but not boiling. Whisk in 100g chopped milk chocolate, 50g chopped dark chocolate and 1 tbsp cocoa until smooth and frothy. Stir in 1/4 tsp peppermint extract. Pour into 4 mugs and top each with a big spoon of whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream. Hang a candy cane on each mug to stir.
